title: Vehicle Repair Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: General Vehicle Repair: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Vehicle Repair Estimate Worksheet covers vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision. The service advisor records General Vehicle Repair observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Vehicle Repair Estimate Worksheet keeps General Vehicle Repair exceptions visible until the service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Vehicle Repair Estimate Worksheet at repair facility, service bay, test area, and customer handoff point. Document vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision identity before General Vehicle Repair begins. Compare vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision findings with stated General Vehicle Repair criteria; route unresolved General Vehicle Repair issues to qualified automotive repair reviewer. For Vehicle Repair Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for General Vehicle Repair. Ask qualified automotive repair reviewer to review General Vehicle Repair conditions beyond the service advisor's role.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when a safety-critical condition, uncertain diagnosis, authorization gap, or failed verification remains. Protect vehicle system, reported symptom, diagnostic result, repair operation, part, and roadworthiness decision; document the General Vehicle Repair notification and await qualified automotive repair reviewer direction.
